evidence.reason: The loop accepts any ancestor SHA, including a merge commit, and runs `diff-tree` without `-m`, `-c`, or `--cc`. Git emits no changed paths for a merge commit under those options, so `changed` omits every path repaired by that merge. If `input.anchors` names only some of those paths, the proof never compares the rest, and a later revert of an omitted repaired path can be accepted. The code needs to reject merge commits before `diff-tree` or expand/require their non-merge constituent commits.
